headline: Coca-Cola HBC Secures Listing Approval for $2.6 Billion African Bottler Acquisition
summary: Coca-Cola HBC secured approval to list on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, satisfying a key final condition to acquire Africa's largest Coca-Cola bottling business for $2.6 billion.
why: The transaction will establish Coca-Cola HBC as the world's second-largest anchor bottler for The Coca-Cola Company.

impacts.name: Coca-Cola HBC
impacts.why: Company obtained cross-listing approval to finalize its $2.6 billion African expansion.
